name: Getting started
description: Kill your first creature.
hint: Complete the basic catch-and-combat loop.
imageAlt: Official Steam achievement icon for Getting started

name: Drip
description: Kill a drip creature.
hint: Watch for a rainbow-name variant, kill it, then confirm the Drip entry with Tab.
imageAlt: Official Steam achievement icon for Drip

name: Who stole my beer
description: Find and kill the culprit, and bring it to the lighthouse keeper.
hint: Use the Empty Beer Can for Spider Crab and return the required quest result.
imageAlt: Official Steam achievement icon for Who stole my beer

name: Noob
description: Get a kill with no kill score multiplier.
hint: Finish a grounded creature without distance, spin, no-scope or other style conditions.
imageAlt: Official Steam achievement icon for Noob

name: Getting an upgrade
description: Upgrade the engine on the boat.
hint: Purchase the first engine improvement.
imageAlt: Official Steam achievement icon for Getting an upgrade

name: Dinnertime
description: Catch dinner for the lady in the forest.
hint: Accept the Forest Island quest and return with the requested catch.
imageAlt: Official Steam achievement icon for Dinnertime

name: Let me go
description: Get picked up by a seagull.
hint: Stay exposed near a hostile seagull and allow the interaction.
imageAlt: Official Steam achievement icon for Let me go

name: Impressive
description: Get a 5x killscore multiplier.
hint: Stack several style conditions on one predictable target.
imageAlt: Official Steam achievement icon for Impressive

name: Grillmaster
description: Start the grill.
hint: Bring Blue Shark to the Grillmaster and start the grill.
imageAlt: Official Steam achievement icon for Grillmaster

name: GOLD GOLD GOLD
description: Unlock a legendary skin from the slot machine.
hint: Feed a Drip creature to the Reel of Fortune; the legendary result is random.
imageAlt: Official Steam achievement icon for GOLD GOLD GOLD

name: Vacation
description: Help the tourist swim on his vacation.
hint: Complete the tourist's physics-based water objective.
imageAlt: Official Steam achievement icon for Vacation

name: 360 no scope
description: Kill a creature with a 360 no scope.
hint: Lower a weak target first, make a full spin, then land the unscoped finishing shot.
imageAlt: Official Steam achievement icon for 360 no scope

name: I am speed
description: Buy the best engine for the boat.
hint: Complete the boat-engine upgrade chain.
imageAlt: Official Steam achievement icon for I am speed

name: Fully equipped
description: Apply all attachments to a single weapon.
hint: Fill the magazine, laser, optic and muzzle slots on one weapon.
imageAlt: Official Steam achievement icon for Fully equipped

name: Yummy in my tummy
description: Eat a burnt creature.
hint: Leave a catch on the grill until black, then consume it.
imageAlt: Official Steam achievement icon for Yummy in my tummy

name: Terrorizing bird
description: Defend the scared islanders from the terrorizing bird.
hint: Use the Tuna-to-Albatross chain and return the bird's head.
imageAlt: Official Steam achievement icon for Terrorizing bird

name: Deadliest catch
description: Help the military defeat the big creature they located.
hint: Complete the military's large-creature encounter on the final route.
imageAlt: Official Steam achievement icon for Deadliest catch

name: We are so back
description: Finish the game.
hint: Complete the five-stage story route and final whale encounter.
imageAlt: Official Steam achievement icon for We are so back

name: All in
description: Bet on green and win at roulette.
hint: Green is one pocket in 37; use only an item you can afford to lose.
imageAlt: Official Steam achievement icon for All in

name: Competitive eating
description: Eat a mini-boss.
hint: Preserve an optional early mini-boss and consume it.
imageAlt: Official Steam achievement icon for Competitive eating

name: Easy
description: Kill a boss within 10 seconds.
hint: Return over-equipped to an early boss and front-load damage.
imageAlt: Official Steam achievement icon for Easy

name: I'm the bird now
description: Make the boat fly.
hint: Use dynamite and the game's physics to launch the boat.
imageAlt: Official Steam achievement icon for I'm the bird now

name: Collector
description: Find and kill all the creatures.
hint: Use the Tab encyclopedia and include optional boss-lure encounters.
imageAlt: Official Steam achievement icon for Collector

name: Rich! Millionaire
description: Sell something worth 100,000 or more.
hint: Stack Killscore and 1.5x cooking on a high-value item, then use roulette green to reach the threshold.
imageAlt: Official Steam achievement icon for Rich! Millionaire

name: Everyone's dream
description: Kill a seagull with dynamite.
hint: Lead the flight path and time the detonation in open space.
imageAlt: Official Steam achievement icon for Everyone's dream

name: Handyman
description: Defeat the final boss with your bare hands.
hint: Attempt after a normal clear; learn the fight before the fists-only challenge run.
imageAlt: Official Steam achievement icon for Handyman

name: Fishipedia
description: Find and kill all drip creatures.
hint: Use the separate Drip entries in the Tab encyclopedia as the checklist.
imageAlt: Official Steam achievement icon for Fishipedia

name: Bean
description: Finish the game within 1 hour.
hint: Use a practiced solo route and buy only progression-critical upgrades.
imageAlt: Official Steam achievement icon for Bean
